proposals.name: commit_message_imperative
proposals.instructions: Does the commit message use the imperative mood, stating the change as a command?

criteria.imperative: The message states the change as a command: add validator, fix crash.
criteria.other: Any other mood: past tense, noun phrase, or a subject-only message on a non-formatting change.

proposals.name: test_sleeps
proposals.instructions: Does this test rely on a fixed delay such as Process.sleep instead of waiting on a condition?
